faqs.a: 🏦 We work with SBI, HDFC and ICICI for home loans up to 80–90% of the property value. Rough EMI: ₹50L for 20 years at 8.5% ≈ ₹43,400/month. Reply *human* for a free eligibility check.
✅ All our projects are TS-RERA registered. We share the RERA number and approved layout before your visit.
Skyline Meadows is ready to move. Skyline Crest possession is planned for Dec 2027 (as per RERA).
There's no brokerage on our own projects. Rentals carry a one-time fee of 15 days' rent.
🌏 We handle NRI purchases end to end, including video site visits and power-of-attorney guidance.
